MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 8
   C. 32
   D. 9

2. Solve for x: x + 9 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 9
   C. 9
   D. 17

3. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

4. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 122

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

7. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 41

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 41
   C. 43
   D. 31

9. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 26

10. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

11. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 30
   C. 19
   D. 38

13. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

14. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 44
   C. 30
   D. 22

16. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.205

17. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

18. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

19. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

20. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 1000 m²

21. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 33

22. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

23. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

24. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 23

25. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 12

26. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

27. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 21

28. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

29. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

30. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 57
   C. 15
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
